options: A method of handling data in large quantities by grouping it into sets and processing those sets together at scheduled intervals
A method of processing each piece of data the instant it arrives
A technique for streaming video to many devices at once
A way of encrypting data before it is transmitted
A process for converting analogue records into digital form
questions.explanation: Batch processing handles data in large quantities by grouping it into sets, or batches, and processing those sets together at scheduled intervals.

questions.stem: How does batch processing differ from real-time processing?
options: Batch processing handles data immediately, while real-time processing waits
Batch processing accumulates data over a period and then processes it as a group, whereas real-time processing handles data immediately
Batch processing only works with images, while real-time processing works with text
Batch processing requires no hardware, while real-time processing needs servers
There is no difference; the terms are interchangeable
questions.explanation: Unlike real-time processing, where data is handled immediately, batch processing involves accumulating data over a period and then processing it as a group.

questions.stem: Which everyday analogy is used to explain batch processing?
options: Water flowing continuously in a river
A card catalogue in a library
Doing your homework assignments at the end of the day rather than right after each class
A game with friends from different countries
Superheroes keeping information accurate
questions.explanation: Batch processing is compared to doing your homework at the end of the day rather than right after each class: you collect all the tasks and work on them together.

questions.stem: Which example describes batch processing in a bank?
options: A credit card purchase appears in the account balance instantly
A cash machine displays the balance in real time
A customer receives a text message the moment a payment is made
Account balances and transactions are updated overnight, processing all of the day's transactions together
Fraud alerts are raised the second a suspicious payment occurs
questions.explanation: Banks often update account balances and transactions overnight, processing all the transactions that occurred during the day in a batch.

questions.stem: How is payroll described as an example of batch processing?
options: Salaries are paid the moment each hour of work is completed
Employees are paid in cash at the end of every shift
Payroll is calculated separately for each employee every day
Salaries are calculated by an external bank in real time
Work hours, overtime and other payroll information are collected over a pay period and processed together to generate pay
questions.explanation: Companies process payroll in batches: employee work hours, overtime and related information are collected over a pay period and processed together.

questions.stem: In the inventory management example of batch processing, when are inventory levels adjusted?
options: During a nightly batch process, using sales data collected throughout the day
Immediately after each individual sale
Only when a customer complains about a missing item
Once a year during a stock take
Whenever a supplier sends an invoice
questions.explanation: Retailers may collect sales data throughout the day and adjust inventory levels during a nightly batch process rather than after each sale.

questions.stem: How do utility companies apply batch processing to billing and invoicing?
options: They generate a bill for each customer as soon as a service is used
They create bills for all customers in a batch at the end of the billing cycle
They only bill customers who request an invoice
They send invoices in real time through a streaming service
They bill customers once every ten years
questions.explanation: Instead of generating a bill for each customer as soon as they use a service, utility companies create bills in a batch at the end of the billing cycle.

questions.stem: What does batch photo editing involve?
options: Editing a single photo repeatedly until it is perfect
Printing photographs one at a time
Applying the same set of edits, such as resizing, cropping or a filter, to multiple photos together
Streaming photos to a website as they are taken
Deleting all photos older than a year
questions.explanation: In batch photo editing, the same set of edits such as resizing, cropping or applying a filter is applied to a set of pictures processed together in a batch.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT given as an example of batch processing?
options: Grade processing in schools at the end of a grading period
Report generation at daily or monthly intervals
Nightly bank transaction updates
Fitness trackers updating heart rate continuously in real time
Payroll processing at specific intervals
questions.explanation: A fitness tracker continuously updating heart rate is a real-time streaming example; grade processing, report generation, nightly bank updates and payroll are all batch examples.

questions.stem: For what kind of workload is batch processing described as efficient?
options: Tasks that require an immediate response every time
Very small volumes of data that change constantly
Video calls between two people
Live traffic signal optimisation
Large volumes of data and tasks that do not require immediate processing
questions.explanation: Batch processing is efficient for handling large volumes of data and tasks that do not require immediate processing, streamlining operations and managing resources effectively.
